hypothesis.null_hypothesis: The governed pipeline fails a governance, identity, archive or settlement check on real historical data.
hypothesis.purpose: PIPELINE_ACCEPTANCE_ONLY. Not new statistical evidence about SMA 5/20 (the DEV window was already evaluated).
hypothesis.question: Does the governed Phase 5 pipeline run the pre-registered SMA 5/20 TSM baseline once, end to end, on the validated real DEV snapshot with consistent, archived and settled evidence?
hypothesis.testable_claim: One governed execution yields an evidence-verified, settled and reproducible archive; no performance claim is made or tested.

market_mechanism.causal_logic: Information is incorporated gradually (order splitting by large holders, ADR catching up with Taiwan-hours news), producing short-horizon serial correlation that a fast/slow moving-average crossing can detect. This is an untested hypothesis, not evidence that SMA is profitable.
failure_modes: Sample far below the pre-registered minimum trade count on a one-month window.

pit_requirements: Use only fully completed bars and original timestamps.
Never access Holdout HOLDOUT-TSM-15M-v1; Development snapshot only.
